note: Bank Asia's schedule of charges (effective July 2026): a current account's maintenance fee is 300 taka a half-year, written before the VAT the schedule applies "as per NBR rules" without a rate. Its savings account's fee rises with the average balance and is nothing up to 10,000 taka, a waiver below a figure that the game doesn't write, so it isn't taken.

sources.title: Bank Asia, Schedule of Charges (effective July 2026)
sources.said: Effective from July 2026 ... Current Account: ... Account maintenance fee (Half-Yearly) Tk. 300 ... For average balance up to Tk. 10,000 No Maintenance Fee ... * VAT applicable as per NBR rules
